import math

class Frame(int node, int position)

int[][] strong_components(int[][] adjacency)
    count := int(#adjacency)
    order := array(nat(count), fill = -1)
    low := array(nat(count), fill = 0)
    on_stack := array(nat(count), fill = false)
    int[] stack := []
    int[][] groups := []
    counter := 0
    for: root < count
        if order[root] != -1
            continue
        order[root] = counter
        low[root] = counter
        counter += 1
        stack = stack.append(root)
        on_stack[root] = true
        work := [Frame(root, 0)]
        while #work != 0
            last := int(#work) - 1
            node := work[last].node
            position := work[last].position
            if position < int(#adjacency[node])
                work[last].position += 1
                child := adjacency[node][position]
                if order[child] == -1
                    order[child] = counter
                    low[child] = counter
                    counter += 1
                    stack = stack.append(child)
                    on_stack[child] = true
                    work = work.append(Frame(child, 0))
                elif on_stack[child]
                    low[node] = math.min(low[node], order[child])
                continue
            work = work[0:<last]
            if #work > 0
                parent := work[-1].node
                low[parent] = math.min(low[parent], low[node])
            if low[node] == order[node]
                int[] group := []
                while true
                    member := stack[-1]
                    stack = stack[0:<#stack - 1]
                    on_stack[member] = false
                    group = group.append(member)
                    if member == node
                        break
                groups = groups.append(group)
    return groups

bool[] reachable(int[][] adjacency, int[] starts)
    seen := array(#adjacency, fill = false)
    int[] stack := []
    for node := starts[]
        if not seen[node]
            seen[node] = true
            stack = stack.append(node)
    while #stack != 0
        node := stack[-1]
        stack = stack[0:<#stack - 1]
        for neighbor := adjacency[node][]
            if not seen[neighbor]
                seen[neighbor] = true
                stack = stack.append(neighbor)
    return seen

int[] bfs_distances(int[][] adjacency, int[] starts)
    distances := array(#adjacency, fill = -1)
    int[] queue := []
    for node := starts[]
        if distances[node] == -1
            distances[node] = 0
            queue = queue.append(node)
    head := 0
    while head < int(#queue)
        node := queue[head]
        head += 1
        for neighbor := adjacency[node][]
            if distances[neighbor] == -1
                distances[neighbor] = distances[node] + 1
                queue = queue.append(neighbor)
    return distances

int[] weak_components(int[][] neighbors)
    labels := array(#neighbors, fill = -1)
    count := 0
    for: start < int(#neighbors)
        if labels[start] != -1
            continue
        labels[start] = count
        stack := [start]
        while #stack != 0
            node := stack[-1]
            stack = stack[0:<#stack - 1]
            for neighbor := neighbors[node][]
                if labels[neighbor] == -1
                    labels[neighbor] = count
                    stack = stack.append(neighbor)
        count += 1
    return labels

string[] read_lines(string path)
    source_text := string.from_utf8(file.read_bin(path))
    string[] lines := source_text.split(NL)
    return lines[0:<#lines - 1]

string[] parameter_fields(string line)
    words := line.split(" ")
    return words[1:<#words]

class Page(int id, string host, string title)
    string[] words := title.split(" ")

class Record(int line, int source, int target)
class Link(int source, int target)
class Query(int number, string[] words, int[] seeds)

class Settings(local string[] lines)
    damping := real64(parameter_fields(lines[0])[0])
    iterations := int(parameter_fields(lines[1])[0])
    tolerance := real64(parameter_fields(lines[2])[0])
    real64[] sweep := [for value := parameter_fields(lines[3])[] then real64(value)]
    int[] trusted := [for value := parameter_fields(lines[4])[] then int(value)]
    spam_top := int(parameter_fields(lines[5])[0])
    spam_threshold := real64(parameter_fields(lines[6])[0])
    hits_iterations := int(parameter_fields(lines[7])[0])
    top_k := int(parameter_fields(lines[8])[0])
    root_limit := int(parameter_fields(lines[9])[0])
    neighbor_limit := int(parameter_fields(lines[10])[0])

class Input(Page[] pages, Record[] records, Query[] queries, Settings settings)

Input read_input()
    Page[] pages := []
    page_lines := read_lines("input/pages.csv")
    for line := page_lines[1:<#page_lines][]
        fields := line.split(",")
        page := Page(int(fields[0]), fields[1], fields[2])
        position := int(#pages)
        pages = pages.append(page)
        while position > 0 and pages[position - 1].id > page.id
            pages[position] = pages[position - 1]
            position -= 1
        pages[position] = page
    Record[] records := []
    link_lines := read_lines("input/links.csv")
    for: 1 <= i < int(#link_lines)
        fields := link_lines[i].split(",")
        records = records.append(Record(i + 1, int(fields[0]), int(fields[1])))
    Query[] queries := []
    for line := read_lines("input/queries.txt")[]
        parts := line.split(" | ")
        int[] seeds := [for value := parts[1].split(" ")[] then int(value)]
        queries = queries.append(Query(int(#queries) + 1, parts[0].split(" "), seeds))
    return Input(pages, records, queries, Settings(read_lines("input/params.txt")))

import math
import graph_io = "./graph_io.qui"

class Result(real64[] authority, real64[] hub)

Result iterate(int count, int[] nodes, graph_io.Link[] links, int iterations)
    int[] empty_neighbors := []
    int[][] sources := array(nat(count), fill = empty_neighbors)
    int[][] targets := array(nat(count), fill = empty_neighbors)
    for link := links[]
        sources[link.target] = sources[link.target].append(link.source)
        targets[link.source] = targets[link.source].append(link.target)
    for: node < count
        sources[node] = sources[node].sorted()
        targets[node] = targets[node].sorted()
    real64[] authority := array(nat(count), fill = 0.0)
    real64[] hub := array(nat(count), fill = 0.0)
    for node := nodes[]
        authority[node] = 1.0
        hub[node] = 1.0
    for: step < iterations
        real64[] incoming := array(nat(count), fill = 0.0)
        real64[] outgoing := array(nat(count), fill = 0.0)
        for node := nodes[]
            incoming[node] = hub[sources[node]].sum()
        for node := nodes[]
            outgoing[node] = incoming[targets[node]].sum()
        real64[] selected_incoming := incoming[nodes]
        real64[] selected_outgoing := outgoing[nodes]
        authority_norm := math.sqrt((selected_incoming * selected_incoming).sum())
        hub_norm := math.sqrt((selected_outgoing * selected_outgoing).sum())
        for node := nodes[]
            authority[node] = incoming[node] / authority_norm
            hub[node] = outgoing[node] / hub_norm
    return Result(authority, hub)

import collections
import math
import graph_io = "./graph_io.qui"
import components = "./components.qui"
import pagerank = "./pagerank.qui"
import hits = "./hits.qui"
import report = "./report.qui"

string[] region_names()
    return ["CORE", "IN", "OUT", "TUBE", "IN_TENDRIL", "OUT_TENDRIL", "OTHER"]

string[] quantity_names()
    return ["in_degree", "pagerank", "cheirank", "authority", "hub", "trustrank", "harmonic"]

int[] rank_order(real64[] values)
    scaled_values := [for value := values[] then report.scaled(value)]
    int[] order := []
    for: i < int(#values)
        position := int(#order)
        order = order.append(i)
        while position > 0 and scaled_values[i] > scaled_values[order[position - 1]]
            order[position] = order[position - 1]
            position -= 1
        order[position] = i
    return order

int[] positions(int[] order)
    ranks := array(#order, fill = 0)
    for: i < int(#order)
        ranks[order[i]] = i + 1
    return ranks

int[] take(int[] values, int limit)
    return values[0:<math.min(int(#values), limit)]

int[] top_list(real64[] values, int limit)
    positive := [for node := rank_order(values)[] if report.scaled(values[node]) > 0 then node]
    return take(positive, limit)

int[] ranked_counts(int[] counts, int limit)
    positive := [for node := rank_order(real64(counts))[] if counts[node] > 0 then node]
    return take(positive, limit)

string[] distribution(int[] values)
    ordered := values.sorted()
    string[] lines := []
    position := 0
    while position < int(#ordered)
        value := ordered[position]
        count := 0
        while position < int(#ordered) and ordered[position] == value
            count += 1
            position += 1
        lines = lines.append("{value} {count}")
    return lines

string joined(string prefix, int[] values)
    return if #values == 0 then prefix else prefix + " " + report.integers(values)

string[] blocks(string[][] sections)
    string[] lines := []
    for section := sections[]
        if #lines > 0
            lines = lines.append("")
        lines = lines.concat(section)
    return lines

string kendall(int[] first, int[] second)
    result := 0
    count := int(#first)
    for: i < count
        for: i + 1 <= j < count
            x := first[i] - first[j]
            y := second[i] - second[j]
            if x != 0 and y != 0
                result += if (x > 0) == (y > 0) then 1 else -1
    return report.fraction(result, count * (count - 1) / 2)

class Graph(graph_io.Page[] pages, local graph_io.Link[] input_links)
    n := int(#pages)
    bool[][] present := array(nat(n), fill = array(nat(n), fill = false))
    for edge := input_links[]
        present[edge.source][edge.target] = true
    graph_io.Link[] links := []
    local int[] empty_neighbors := []
    int[][] successors := array(nat(n), fill = empty_neighbors)
    int[][] predecessors := array(nat(n), fill = empty_neighbors)
    for: source < n
        for: target < n
            if present[source][target]
                links = links.append(graph_io.Link(source, target))
                successors[source] = successors[source].append(target)
                predecessors[target] = predecessors[target].append(source)

    bool intra(int source, int target)
        return pages[source].host == pages[target].host

    graph_io.Link[] inter_links()
        return [for edge := links[] if not intra(edge.source, edge.target) then edge]

    pagerank.Edge[][] edges(reverse := false)
        neighbors := if reverse then successors else predecessors
        return [for group := neighbors[] then [for source := group[] then pagerank.Edge(source, 1)]]

    int[] dangling()
        return [for node := (0:<n)[] if #successors[node] == 0 then node]

    int[] ids(int[] nodes)
        return [for node := nodes[] then pages[node].id]

    string describe(int rank, int node, string value)
        return "{rank} {pages[node].id} {value} {pages[node].host} {pages[node].title}"

class Undirected(local Graph graph)
    local bool[][] adjacent := array(nat(graph.n), fill = array(nat(graph.n), fill = false))
    for edge := graph.links[]
        adjacent[edge.source][edge.target] = true
        adjacent[edge.target][edge.source] = true
    int[][] neighbors := [for node := (0:<graph.n)[] then [for other := (0:<graph.n)[] if adjacent[node][other] then other]]
    int edge_count := [for group := neighbors[] then int(#group)].sum() / 2
    closed := 0
    possible := 0
    eligible := 0
    local real64[] coefficients := []
    for group := neighbors[]
        degree := int(#group)
        if degree < 2
            continue
        triangles := 0
        for: i < degree
            for: i + 1 <= j < degree
                if adjacent[group[i]][group[j]]
                    triangles += 1
        pairs := degree * (degree - 1) / 2
        closed += triangles
        possible += pairs
        eligible += 1
        coefficients = coefficients.append(real64(triangles) / real64(pairs))
    real64 average_clustering := coefficients.sum() / real64(eligible)
    kcore := array(nat(graph.n), fill = 0)
    local remaining := [for group := neighbors[] then int(#group)]
    local removed := array(nat(graph.n), fill = false)
    local level := 0
    local left := graph.n
    while left > 0
        selected := -1
        for: node < graph.n
            if not removed[node] and remaining[node] <= level
                selected = node
                break
        if selected < 0
            level += 1
            continue
        removed[selected] = true
        kcore[selected] = level
        left -= 1
        for neighbor := neighbors[selected][]
            if not removed[neighbor]
                remaining[neighbor] -= 1
    int degeneracy := kcore.max()
    local weak_labels := components.weak_components(neighbors)
    int weak_count := weak_labels.max() + 1
    local weak_sizes := array(nat(weak_count), fill = 0)
    for label := weak_labels[]
        weak_sizes[label] += 1
    int weak_largest := weak_sizes.max()

class ComponentTable(local Graph graph)
    int[][] groups := components.strong_components(graph.successors)
    for: i < int(#groups)
        groups[i] = groups[i].sorted()
    for: 1 <= i < int(#groups)
        current := groups[i]
        position := i
        while position > 0 and current[0] < groups[position - 1][0]
            groups[position] = groups[position - 1]
            position -= 1
        groups[position] = current
    labels := array(nat(graph.n), fill = 0)
    for: i < int(#groups)
        for node := groups[i][]
            labels[node] = i
    incoming := array(#groups, fill = 0)
    outgoing := array(#groups, fill = 0)
    local bool[][] condensed := array(#groups, fill = array(#groups, fill = false))
    edge_count := 0
    for edge := graph.links[]
        int first := labels[edge.source]
        int second := labels[edge.target]
        if first != second
            outgoing[first] += 1
            incoming[second] += 1
            if not condensed[first][second]
                condensed[first][second] = true
                edge_count += 1
    local count := int(#groups)
    local next_nodes := [for node := (0:<count)[] then [for target := (0:<count)[] if condensed[node][target] then target]]
    local pending := array(nat(count), fill = 0)
    for next_group := next_nodes[]
        for target := next_group[]
            pending[target] += 1
    local ready := [for node := (0:<count)[] if pending[node] == 0 then node]
    local lengths := array(nat(count), fill = 0)
    while #ready != 0
        node := ready[-1]
        ready = ready[0:<#ready - 1]
        for target := next_nodes[node][]
            lengths[target] = math.max(lengths[target], lengths[node] + 1)
            pending[target] -= 1
            if pending[target] == 0
                ready = ready.append(target)
    int depth := lengths.max()
    core := 0
    for: 1 <= i < count
        if #groups[i] > #groups[core]
            core = i
    int singletons := [for group := groups[] if #group == 1 then 1].sum()

int[] bowtie(Graph graph, int[] core_pages)
    forward := components.reachable(graph.successors, core_pages)
    backward := components.reachable(graph.predecessors, core_pages)
    in_core := array(nat(graph.n), fill = false)
    for node := core_pages[]
        in_core[node] = true
    regions := array(nat(graph.n), fill = 6)
    for: node < graph.n
        if in_core[node]
            regions[node] = 0
        elif backward[node]
            regions[node] = 1
        elif forward[node]
            regions[node] = 2
    in_pages := [for node := (0:<graph.n)[] if regions[node] == 1 then node]
    out_pages := [for node := (0:<graph.n)[] if regions[node] == 2 then node]
    from_in := components.reachable(graph.successors, in_pages)
    to_out := components.reachable(graph.predecessors, out_pages)
    for: node < graph.n
        if regions[node] != 6
            continue
        if from_in[node] and to_out[node]
            regions[node] = 3
        elif from_in[node]
            regions[node] = 4
        elif to_out[node]
            regions[node] = 5
    return regions

class DistanceStats(local Graph graph)
    pair_count := 0
    distance_sum := 0
    diameter := 0
    diameter_source := -1
    diameter_target := -1
    histogram := array(nat(graph.n), fill = 0)
    real64[] harmonic := array(nat(graph.n), fill = 0.0)
    for: source < graph.n
        distances := components.bfs_distances(graph.successors, [source])
        for: target < graph.n
            steps := distances[target]
            if source == target or steps < 0
                continue
            pair_count += 1
            distance_sum += steps
            histogram[steps] += 1
            harmonic[target] += 1.0 / real64(steps)
            if steps > diameter
                diameter = steps
                diameter_source = source
                diameter_target = target
    effective_diameter := diameter
    local reached := 0
    for: 1 <= steps <= diameter
        reached += histogram[steps]
        if 10 * reached >= 9 * pair_count
            effective_diameter = steps
            break

class Scores(local Graph graph, local graph_io.Settings settings, local int[] trusted, real64[] harmonic)
    local everyone := 0:<graph.n
    pagerank.Result pr_run := pagerank.power_iteration(graph.edges(), everyone, settings.damping, settings.iterations, settings.tolerance)
    pagerank.Result chei_run := pagerank.power_iteration(graph.edges(true), everyone, settings.damping, settings.iterations, settings.tolerance)
    pagerank.Result trust_run := pagerank.power_iteration(graph.edges(), trusted, settings.damping, settings.iterations, settings.tolerance)
    real64[] page_rank := pr_run.values
    real64[] cheirank := chei_run.values
    real64[] trustrank := trust_run.values
    order := rank_order(page_rank)
    ranks := positions(order)
    chei_ranks := positions(rank_order(cheirank))
    trust_ratio := trustrank / page_rank
    int[] trust_distance := components.bfs_distances(graph.successors, trusted)
    local all_hits := hits.iterate(graph.n, everyone, graph.inter_links(), settings.hits_iterations)
    real64[] authority := all_hits.authority
    real64[] hub := all_hits.hub

class Sweep(real64 damping, local Graph graph, local Scores scores, local graph_io.Settings settings)
    pagerank.Result result := pagerank.power_iteration(graph.edges(), 0:<graph.n, damping, settings.iterations, settings.tolerance)
    local order := rank_order(result.values)
    local ranks := positions(order)
    overlap := 0
    footrule := 0
    shift := 0
    for: node < graph.n
        if ranks[node] <= settings.top_k and scores.ranks[node] <= settings.top_k
            overlap += 1
        footrule += math.abs(ranks[node] - scores.ranks[node])
        if math.abs(ranks[node] - scores.ranks[node]) > math.abs(ranks[shift] - scores.ranks[shift])
            shift = node
    int shift_rank := ranks[shift]
    int[] top := take(order, settings.top_k)
    string correlation := kendall([for value := scores.page_rank[] then report.scaled(value)], [for value := result.values[] then report.scaled(value)])

class Spam(local Graph graph, local Scores scores, local graph_io.Settings settings)
    int[] suspects := [for node := take(scores.order, settings.spam_top)[] if real64(report.scaled(scores.trust_ratio[node], 4)) / 10000.0 < settings.spam_threshold then node]
    local distinct<string> host_set
    for node := suspects[]
        .host_set.add(graph.pages[node].host)
    string[] hosts := host_set.sorted()
    removed := 0
    pagerank.Result | none demoted := none
    int[] ranks := []
    if #suspects > 0
        graph_io.Link[] kept := []
        for edge := graph.links[]
            if graph.intra(edge.source, edge.target) and host_set.has(graph.pages[edge.source].host)
                removed += 1
            else
                kept = kept.append(edge)
        reduced_graph := Graph(graph.pages, kept)
        result := pagerank.power_iteration(reduced_graph.edges(), 0:<graph.n, settings.damping, settings.iterations, settings.tolerance)
        demoted = result
        ranks = positions(rank_order(result.values))

real64[] salsa(int count, graph_io.Link[] links)
    degree := array(nat(count), fill = 0)
    int[] empty_neighbors := []
    int[][] targets := array(nat(count), fill = empty_neighbors)
    int[][] neighbors := array(nat(count), fill = empty_neighbors)
    for edge := links[]
        degree[edge.target] += 1
        targets[edge.source] = targets[edge.source].append(edge.target)
    for group := targets[]
        for: i < int(#group) - 1
            neighbors[group[i]] = neighbors[group[i]].append(group[i + 1])
            neighbors[group[i + 1]] = neighbors[group[i + 1]].append(group[i])
    labels := components.weak_components(neighbors)
    sizes := array(nat(count), fill = 0)
    mass := array(nat(count), fill = 0)
    side := 0
    for: node < count
        if degree[node] > 0
            side += 1
            sizes[labels[node]] += 1
            mass[labels[node]] += degree[node]
    return [for node := (0:<count)[] then if degree[node] == 0 then 0.0 else real64(sizes[labels[node]] * degree[node]) / real64(side * mass[labels[node]])]

class Subgraph(local Graph graph, local int[] base, local graph_io.Link[] links, local graph_io.Settings settings)
    local hit_scores := hits.iterate(graph.n, base, links, settings.hits_iterations)
    real64[] authority := hit_scores.authority
    real64[] hub := hit_scores.hub
    real64[] salsa_authority := salsa(graph.n, links)
    real64[] salsa_hub := salsa(graph.n, [for edge := links[] then graph_io.Link(edge.target, edge.source)])
    int[] authority_top := top_list(authority, settings.top_k)
    int[] hub_top := top_list(hub, settings.top_k)
    int[] salsa_authority_top := top_list(salsa_authority, settings.top_k)
    int[] salsa_hub_top := top_list(salsa_hub, settings.top_k)
    local authority_selected := array(nat(graph.n), fill = false)
    local hub_selected := array(nat(graph.n), fill = false)
    for node := salsa_authority_top[]
        authority_selected[node] = true
    for node := salsa_hub_top[]
        hub_selected[node] = true
    int authority_overlap := [for node := authority_top[] if authority_selected[node] then 1].sum()
    int hub_overlap := [for node := hub_top[] if hub_selected[node] then 1].sum()
    local distinct<string> host_set
    for node := authority_top[]
        .host_set.add(graph.pages[node].host)
    authority_hosts := int(host_set.size())
    int cited := authority_top[0]
    int citing := hub_top[0]
    cocitation := array(nat(graph.n), fill = 0)
    coupling := array(nat(graph.n), fill = 0)
    for source := graph.predecessors[cited][]
        for target := graph.successors[source][]
            if target != cited
                cocitation[target] += 1
    for target := graph.successors[citing][]
        for source := graph.predecessors[target][]
            if source != citing
                coupling[source] += 1
    int[] related := ranked_counts(cocitation, settings.top_k)
    int[] similar := ranked_counts(coupling, settings.top_k)

bool title_matches(string[] title, string[] query)
    for word := query[]
        excluded := word[0] == "-"
        wanted := if excluded then word[1:<#word] else word
        found := false
        for item := title[]
            if item == wanted
                found = true
                break
        if (excluded and found) or (not excluded and not found)
            return false
    return true

class QueryResult(graph_io.Query query, local Graph graph, local Scores scores, local graph_io.Settings settings, local int[] index_by_id)
    int[] matches := [for node := scores.order[] if title_matches(graph.pages[node].words, query.words) then node]
    local root := take(matches, settings.root_limit)
    root_size := int(#root)
    local included := array(nat(graph.n), fill = false)
    for node := root[]
        included[node] = true
        for neighbor := take(graph.successors[node], settings.neighbor_limit)[]
            included[neighbor] = true
        for neighbor := take(graph.predecessors[node], settings.neighbor_limit)[]
            included[neighbor] = true
    local base := [for node := (0:<graph.n)[] if included[node] then node]
    base_size := int(#base)
    graph_io.Link[] links := []
    dropped := 0
    for edge := graph.links[]
        if included[edge.source] and included[edge.target]
            if graph.intra(edge.source, edge.target)
                dropped += 1
            else
                links = links.append(edge)
    local seeds := ([for id := query.seeds[] then index_by_id[id]]).sorted()
    pagerank.Result personalized := pagerank.power_iteration(graph.edges(), seeds, settings.damping, settings.iterations, settings.tolerance)
    int reach := [for seen := components.reachable(graph.successors, seeds)[] if seen then 1].sum()
    real64 seed_mass := personalized.values[seeds].sum()
    int[] personal_top := top_list(personalized.values, settings.top_k)
    int global_overlap := [for node := personal_top[] if scores.ranks[node] <= settings.top_k then 1].sum()
    Subgraph | none subgraph := if #links == 0 then none else Subgraph(graph, base, links, settings)

int host_position(string[] names, string wanted)
    for: i < int(#names)
        if names[i] == wanted
            return i
    return -1

class HostGraph(local Graph graph, local graph_io.Settings settings)
    local distinct<string> host_set
    for page := graph.pages[]
        .host_set.add(page.host)
    string[] names := host_set.sorted()
    local count := int(#names)
    local int[] empty_members := []
    int[][] members := array(nat(count), fill = empty_members)
    local int[] of_page := []
    for: node < graph.n
        host := host_position(names, graph.pages[node].host)
        of_page = of_page.append(host)
        members[host] = members[host].append(node)
    int[][] weight := array(nat(count), fill = array(nat(count), fill = 0))
    internal := array(nat(count), fill = 0)
    outgoing := array(nat(count), fill = 0)
    incoming := array(nat(count), fill = 0)
    for edge := graph.links[]
        first := of_page[edge.source]
        second := of_page[edge.target]
        if first == second
            internal[first] += 1
        else
            weight[first][second] += 1
            outgoing[first] += 1
            incoming[second] += 1
    graph_io.Link[] edges := []
    local int[][] adjacency := array(nat(count), fill = empty_members)
    local pagerank.Edge[] empty_edges := []
    local pagerank.Edge[][] in_edges := array(nat(count), fill = empty_edges)
    reciprocal := 0
    for: first < count
        for: second < count
            if weight[first][second] > 0
                edges = edges.append(graph_io.Link(first, second))
                adjacency[first] = adjacency[first].append(second)
                in_edges[second] = in_edges[second].append(pagerank.Edge(first, weight[first][second]))
                if weight[second][first] > 0
                    reciprocal += 1
    local strong_groups := components.strong_components(adjacency)
    component_count := int(#strong_groups)
    int largest := [for group := strong_groups[] then int(#group)].max()
    pagerank.Result result := pagerank.power_iteration(in_edges, 0:<count, settings.damping, settings.iterations, settings.tolerance)
    int[] ranks := positions(rank_order(result.values))
    graph_io.Link[] heavy := []
    for edge := edges[]
        position := int(#heavy)
        heavy = heavy.append(edge)
        while position > 0 and weight[edge.source][edge.target] > weight[heavy[position - 1].source][heavy[position - 1].target]
            heavy[position] = heavy[position - 1]
            position -= 1
        heavy[position] = edge
    heavy = heavy[0:<math.min(int(#heavy), settings.top_k)]

class Ignored(graph_io.Record record, string reason)

string[] convergence_block(string heading, pagerank.Result result)
    lines := ["", heading]
    for: 10 <= step <= int(#result.changes) step 10
        lines = lines.append("iteration {step} l1 {report.fixed(result.changes[step - 1], 10)}")
    converged := if result.converged_at == 0 then "none" else "{result.converged_at}"
    return lines.append("converged_at {converged}")

string[] optional_convergence(string heading, pagerank.Result | none result)
    match result
        none
            return []
        pagerank.Result present
            return convergence_block(heading, present)

class Analysis(graph_io.Input data)
    graph_io.Settings settings := data.settings
    index_by_id := array(10000, fill = -1)
    for: i < int(#data.pages)
        index_by_id[data.pages[i].id] = i
    Ignored[] ignored := []
    local graph_io.Link[] accepted_links := []
    local bool[][] accepted := array(#data.pages, fill = array(#data.pages, fill = false))
    for record := data.records[]
        int source := index_by_id[record.source]
        int target := index_by_id[record.target]
        reason := ""
        if source < 0 or target < 0
            reason = "unknown"
        elif source == target
            reason = "self"
        elif accepted[source][target]
            reason = "duplicate"
        else
            accepted[source][target] = true
            accepted_links = accepted_links.append(graph_io.Link(source, target))
        if reason != ""
            ignored = ignored.append(Ignored(record, reason))
    graph := Graph(data.pages, accepted_links)
    undirected := Undirected(graph)
    component_table := ComponentTable(graph)
    int[] regions := bowtie(graph, component_table.groups[component_table.core])
    distances := DistanceStats(graph)
    local int[] trusted := ([for id := settings.trusted[] then index_by_id[id]]).sorted()
    scores := Scores(graph, settings, trusted, distances.harmonic)
    Sweep[] sweeps := [for damping := settings.sweep[] then Sweep(damping, graph, scores, settings)]
    spam := Spam(graph, scores, settings)
    QueryResult[] queries := [for query := data.queries[] then QueryResult(query, graph, scores, settings, index_by_id)]
    hosts := HostGraph(graph, settings)

    int representative(int[] nodes)
        best := nodes[0]
        for node := nodes[]
            if scores.ranks[node] < scores.ranks[best]
                best = node
        return best

    string[] rank_lines(int[] nodes, real64[] values)
        return [for i := (0:<int(#nodes))[] then graph.describe(i + 1, nodes[i], report.fixed(values[nodes[i]]))]

    string[] graph_stats_file()
        unknown := [for item := ignored[] if item.reason == "unknown" then 1].sum()
        self_links := [for item := ignored[] if item.reason == "self" then 1].sum()
        duplicates := [for item := ignored[] if item.reason == "duplicate" then 1].sum()
        intra := [for edge := graph.links[] if graph.intra(edge.source, edge.target) then 1].sum()
        reciprocal := [for edge := graph.links[] if graph.present[edge.target][edge.source] then 1].sum()
        in_degree := [for group := graph.predecessors[] then int(#group)]
        out_degree := [for group := graph.successors[] then int(#group)]
        max_in := in_degree.max()
        max_out := out_degree.max()
        lines := ["pages {graph.n}", "hosts {#hosts.names}", "link_rows {#data.records}", "links {#graph.links}", "ignored_unknown {unknown}", "ignored_self {self_links}", "ignored_duplicate {duplicates}"]
        for item := ignored[]
            lines = lines.append("ignored line {item.record.line} {item.record.source},{item.record.target} {item.reason}")
        lines = lines.concat(["intra_host_links {intra}", "inter_host_links {int(#graph.links) - intra}", "mean_degree {report.fixed(real64(#graph.links) / real64(graph.n), 4)}", "reciprocity {report.fraction(reciprocal, int(#graph.links))}"])
        int[] dangling := graph.dangling()
        int[] no_in := [for node := (0:<graph.n)[] if in_degree[node] == 0 then node]
        int[] max_in_pages := [for node := (0:<graph.n)[] if in_degree[node] == max_in then node]
        int[] max_out_pages := [for node := (0:<graph.n)[] if out_degree[node] == max_out then node]
        lines = lines.concat([joined("dangling {#dangling}", graph.ids(dangling)), joined("no_in_links {#no_in}", graph.ids(no_in)), joined("max_in_degree {max_in} pages", graph.ids(max_in_pages)), joined("max_out_degree {max_out} pages", graph.ids(max_out_pages))])
        lines = lines.concat(["", "in_degree_distribution"]).concat(distribution(in_degree))
        lines = lines.concat(["", "out_degree_distribution"]).concat(distribution(out_degree))
        degeneracy_pages := [for value := undirected.kcore[] if value == undirected.degeneracy then 1].sum()
        lines = lines.concat(["", "undirected_links {undirected.edge_count}", "transitivity {report.fraction(undirected.closed, undirected.possible)}", "average_clustering {report.fixed(undirected.average_clustering, 4)} pages {undirected.eligible}", "degeneracy {undirected.degeneracy} pages {degeneracy_pages}", "core_distribution"]).concat(distribution(undirected.kcore))
        lines = lines.concat(["", "strong_components {#component_table.groups} largest {#component_table.groups[component_table.core]} singletons {component_table.singletons} condensation_links {component_table.edge_count}", "weak_components {undirected.weak_count} largest {undirected.weak_largest}", "condensation_depth {component_table.depth}"])
        for: i < int(#component_table.groups)
            int[] group := component_table.groups[i]
            if #group < 2
                continue
            suffix := if component_table.outgoing[i] == 0 then " sink" else ""
            real64 mass := scores.page_rank[group].sum()
            lines = lines.append("scc {i + 1} size {#group} min {graph.pages[group[0]].id} incoming {component_table.incoming[i]} outgoing {component_table.outgoing[i]} pagerank {report.fixed(mass)}{suffix}")
        names := region_names()
        lines = lines.concat(["", "bowtie core_scc {component_table.core + 1}"])
        for: region < 7
            int[] members := [for node := (0:<graph.n)[] if regions[node] == region then node]
            text := "{names[region]} {#members} pagerank {report.fixed(scores.page_rank[members].sum())}"
            if #members > 0
                text += " top {graph.pages[representative(members)].id}"
            if 1 <= #members <= 10
                text = joined(text + " pages", graph.ids(members))
            lines = lines.append(text)
        int[][] counts := array(7, fill = array(7, fill = 0))
        for edge := graph.links[]
            counts[regions[edge.source]][regions[edge.target]] += 1
        lines = lines.append("region_links")
        for: first < 7
            for: second < 7
                if counts[first][second] > 0
                    lines = lines.append("{names[first]} {names[second]} {counts[first][second]}")
        lines = lines.concat(["", "distances", "reachable_pairs {distances.pair_count}", "average {report.fraction(distances.distance_sum, distances.pair_count)}", "diameter {distances.diameter} from {graph.pages[distances.diameter_source].id} to {graph.pages[distances.diameter_target].id}", "effective_diameter {distances.effective_diameter}"])
        for: 1 <= int steps <= distances.diameter
            lines = lines.append("{steps} {distances.histogram[steps]}")
        return lines

    string[] pagerank_file()
        names := region_names()
        lines := ["id,in_degree,out_degree,scc,region,kcore,harmonic,pagerank,pagerank_rank,cheirank,cheirank_rank,authority,hub,trustrank,trust_ratio,trust_distance"]
        for: int node < graph.n
            fields := ["{graph.pages[node].id}", "{#graph.predecessors[node]}", "{#graph.successors[node]}", "{component_table.labels[node] + 1}", names[regions[node]], "{undirected.kcore[node]}", report.fixed(scores.harmonic[node]), report.fixed(scores.page_rank[node]), "{scores.ranks[node]}", report.fixed(scores.cheirank[node]), "{scores.chei_ranks[node]}", report.fixed(scores.authority[node]), report.fixed(scores.hub[node]), report.fixed(scores.trustrank[node]), report.fixed(scores.trust_ratio[node], 4), "{scores.trust_distance[node]}"]
            lines = lines.append(fields.join(","))
        return lines

    string[] score_block(string name, real64[] values)
        return ["{name} top {settings.top_k}"].concat(rank_lines(top_list(values, settings.top_k), values))

    string[] pagerank_block()
        nodes := top_list(scores.page_rank, settings.top_k)
        string[] lines := score_block("pagerank", scores.page_rank)
        lines = lines.append("dangling_mass {report.fixed(scores.page_rank[graph.dangling()].sum())}")
        real64[] contributions := [for node := (0:<graph.n)[] then if #graph.successors[node] == 0 then 0.0 else (settings.damping * scores.page_rank[node]) / real64(#graph.successors[node])]
        order := rank_order(contributions)
        for node := nodes[]
            contributors := take([for source := order[] if graph.present[source][node] then source], 3)
            parts := ["contributors", "{graph.pages[node].id}"]
            for source := contributors[]
                parts = parts.concat(["{graph.pages[source].id}", report.fixed(contributions[source])])
            lines = lines.append(parts.join(" "))
        return lines

    string[] correlation_block()
        series := [[for group := graph.predecessors[] then int(#group)]]
        for values := [scores.page_rank, scores.cheirank, scores.authority, scores.hub, scores.trustrank, scores.harmonic][]
            series = series.append([for value := values[] then report.scaled(value)])
        names := quantity_names()
        lines := ["correlation"]
        for: first < 7
            for: first + 1 <= second < 7
                lines = lines.append("{names[first]} {names[second]} {kendall(series[first], series[second])}")
        return lines

    string[] sweep_block()
        lines := ["damping_sweep"]
        for sweep := sweeps[]
            lines = lines.append("damping {report.fixed(sweep.damping, 4)} overlap {sweep.overlap} footrule {sweep.footrule} kendall {sweep.correlation} largest_shift {graph.pages[sweep.shift].id} {scores.ranks[sweep.shift]} {sweep.shift_rank}")
            lines = lines.append(joined("top", graph.ids(sweep.top)))
        return lines

    string[] spam_block()
        lines := ["spam top {settings.spam_top} threshold {report.fixed(settings.spam_threshold, 4)}"]
        for node := spam.suspects[]
            lines = lines.append("suspect {graph.pages[node].id} rank {scores.ranks[node]} pagerank {report.fixed(scores.page_rank[node])} trustrank {report.fixed(scores.trustrank[node])} trust_ratio {report.fixed(scores.trust_ratio[node], 4)} trust_distance {scores.trust_distance[node]} kcore {undirected.kcore[node]} {graph.pages[node].host}")
        lines = lines.concat(["count {#spam.suspects}", "trust_by_distance"])
        distinct<int> distance_set
        for distance := scores.trust_distance[]
            if distance >= 0
                .distance_set.add(distance)
        distance_values := distance_set.sorted()
        for distance := scores.trust_distance[]
            if distance == -1
                distance_values = distance_values.append(-1)
                break
        for distance := distance_values[]
            int[] members := [for node := (0:<graph.n)[] if scores.trust_distance[node] == distance then node]
            label := if distance == -1 then "unreachable" else "{distance}"
            lines = lines.append("{label} pages {#members} trustrank {report.fixed(scores.trustrank[members].sum())} pagerank {report.fixed(scores.page_rank[members].sum())}")
        return lines

    string[] demotion_block()
        match spam.demoted
            none
                return ["demotion none"]
            pagerank.Result result
                string[] lines := ["demotion hosts " + spam.hosts.join(" ") + " removed_links {spam.removed}"]
                top := top_list(result.values, settings.top_k)
                for: i < int(#top)
                    node := top[i]
                    lines = lines.append(graph.describe(i + 1, node, "{report.fixed(result.values[node])} was {scores.ranks[node]}"))
                for node := spam.suspects[]
                    lines = lines.append("suspect {graph.pages[node].id} before {scores.ranks[node]} after {spam.ranks[node]}")
                return lines

    string[] host_block()
        lines := ["host_graph hosts {#hosts.names} links {#hosts.edges} reciprocal {hosts.reciprocal} strong_components {hosts.component_count} largest {hosts.largest}", "host_links top {settings.top_k}"]
        for edge := hosts.heavy[]
            lines = lines.append("{hosts.names[edge.source]} {hosts.names[edge.target]} {hosts.weight[edge.source][edge.target]}")
        return lines

    string[] rankings_file()
        return blocks([pagerank_block(), score_block("cheirank", scores.cheirank), score_block("authority", scores.authority), score_block("hub", scores.hub), score_block("trustrank", scores.trustrank), score_block("harmonic", scores.harmonic), correlation_block(), sweep_block(), spam_block(), demotion_block(), host_block()])

    string[] convergence_file()
        damping := report.fixed(settings.damping, 4)
        lines := ["iterations {settings.iterations} tolerance {report.fixed(settings.tolerance, 10)}"]
        lines = lines.concat(convergence_block("pagerank damping {damping}", scores.pr_run))
        lines = lines.concat(convergence_block("cheirank damping {damping}", scores.chei_run))
        lines = lines.concat(convergence_block("trustrank damping {damping} seeds {#settings.trusted}", scores.trust_run))
        for sweep := sweeps[]
            lines = lines.concat(convergence_block("sweep damping {report.fixed(sweep.damping, 4)}", sweep.result))
        lines = lines.concat(optional_convergence("demoted damping {damping}", spam.demoted))
        for query := queries[]
            lines = lines.concat(convergence_block("personalized query {query.query.number} damping {damping}", query.personalized))
        return lines.concat(convergence_block("host_pagerank damping {damping} hosts {#hosts.names}", hosts.result))

    string[] query_lines(QueryResult result)
        lines := ["query {result.query.number} words " + result.query.words.join(" ") + " seeds " + report.integers(result.query.seeds), "matched {#result.matches} root {result.root_size} base {result.base_size} links {#result.links} dropped_intra_host {result.dropped}", "results"]
        lines = lines.concat(rank_lines(take(result.matches, settings.top_k), scores.page_rank))
        lines = lines.append("personalized reach {result.reach} seed_mass {report.fixed(result.seed_mass)}")
        lines = lines.concat(rank_lines(result.personal_top, result.personalized.values))
        lines = lines.append("overlap_with_global {result.global_overlap}")
        match result.subgraph
            none
                return lines.append("hits none")
            Subgraph sub
                lines = lines.append("hits authorities").concat(rank_lines(sub.authority_top, sub.authority))
                lines = lines.append("hits hubs").concat(rank_lines(sub.hub_top, sub.hub))
                lines = lines.append("salsa authorities").concat(rank_lines(sub.salsa_authority_top, sub.salsa_authority))
                lines = lines.append("salsa hubs").concat(rank_lines(sub.salsa_hub_top, sub.salsa_hub))
                lines = lines.append("hits_salsa_overlap authorities {sub.authority_overlap} hubs {sub.hub_overlap} authority_hosts {sub.authority_hosts}")
                lines = lines.append("related_to {graph.pages[sub.cited].id} citing {#graph.predecessors[sub.cited]}")
                for: i < int(#sub.related)
                    node := sub.related[i]
                    lines = lines.append(graph.describe(i + 1, node, "{sub.cocitation[node]}"))
                lines = lines.append("coupled_to {graph.pages[sub.citing].id} cited {#graph.successors[sub.citing]}")
                for: i < int(#sub.similar)
                    node := sub.similar[i]
                    lines = lines.append(graph.describe(i + 1, node, "{sub.coupling[node]}"))
                return lines

    string[] queries_file()
        return blocks([for result := queries[] then query_lines(result)])

    string[] hosts_file()
        lines := ["host,pages,core_pages,internal_links,internal_density,outgoing_links,incoming_links,dangling_pages,page_score_sum,top_page,score,rank"]
        for: i < int(#hosts.names)
            int[] members := hosts.members[i]
            size := int(#members)
            core := [for node := members[] if regions[node] == 0 then 1].sum()
            dangling := [for node := members[] if #graph.successors[node] == 0 then 1].sum()
            density := if size >= 2 then real64(hosts.internal[i]) / real64(size * (size - 1)) else 0.0
            string[] fields := [hosts.names[i], "{size}", "{core}", "{hosts.internal[i]}", report.fixed(density, 4), "{hosts.outgoing[i]}", "{hosts.incoming[i]}", "{dangling}", report.fixed(scores.page_rank[members].sum()), "{graph.pages[representative(members)].id}", report.fixed(hosts.result.values[i]), "{hosts.ranks[i]}"]
            lines = lines.append(fields.join(","))
        return lines

void run()
    study := Analysis(graph_io.read_input())
    file.mkdir("output")
    report.write_lines("graph_stats.txt", study.graph_stats_file())
    report.write_lines("pagerank.csv", study.pagerank_file())
    report.write_lines("rankings.txt", study.rankings_file())
    report.write_lines("convergence.txt", study.convergence_file())
    report.write_lines("queries.txt", study.queries_file())
    report.write_lines("hosts.csv", study.hosts_file())

if main
    run()

import math

class Edge(int source, int weight)
class Result(real64[] values, real64[] changes, int converged_at)

Result power_iteration(Edge[][] in_edges, int[] teleport, real64 damping, int iterations, real64 tolerance)
    count := int(#in_edges)
    out_weight := array(nat(count), fill = 0)
    for edges := in_edges[]
        for edge := edges[]
            out_weight[edge.source] += edge.weight
    selected := array(nat(count), fill = false)
    for node := teleport[]
        selected[node] = true
    size := int(#teleport)
    values := [for included := selected[] then if included then 1.0 / real64(size) else 0.0]
    real64[] changes := []
    converged_at := 0
    for: 1 <= step <= iterations
        dangling := [for node := (0:<count)[] if out_weight[node] == 0 then values[node]].sum()
        base := ((1.0 - damping) + damping * dangling) / real64(size)
        real64[] updated := []
        for: node < count
            inflow := [for edge := in_edges[node][] then (values[edge.source] * real64(edge.weight)) / real64(out_weight[edge.source])].sum()
            updated = updated.append(if selected[node] then damping * inflow + base else damping * inflow)
        change := math.abs(updated - values).sum()
        changes = changes.append(change)
        values = updated
        if converged_at == 0 and change < tolerance
            converged_at = step
    return Result(values, changes, converged_at)

import math

string fixed(real64 value, places := 6)
    text := if places == 4 then "{value:.4}" elif places == 10 then "{value:.10}" else "{value:.6}"
    if text == "-0.0000"
        return "0.0000"
    if text == "-0.000000"
        return "0.000000"
    if text == "-0.0000000000"
        return "0.0000000000"
    return text

int scaled(real64 value, places := 6)
    real64 multiplier := if places == 4 then 10000.0 else 1000000.0
    rounded := math.round(value * multiplier)
    return rounded

string fraction(int numerator, int denominator)
    first := math.abs(numerator)
    second := denominator
    while second != 0
        first, second = second, first % second
    reduced_numerator := numerator / first
    reduced_denominator := denominator / first
    return "{reduced_numerator}/{reduced_denominator} {fixed(real64(reduced_numerator) / real64(reduced_denominator), 4)}"

string integers(int[] values)
    return [for value := values[] then "{value}"].join(" ")

void write_lines(string name, string[] lines)
    writer1 := file.write("output/" + name)
    .writer1(lines.join(NL) + NL)
